staleness_law: Accepted historical receipts remain immutable. Impact may mark active use stale_pending_revalidation; it does not rewrite history.

revalidate: named court predicate affected by code path

C1_INTERFACE.description: Handoff/schema shape change with unchanged semantic authority.
revalidate: descendant receipts that consume changed fields
C1_INTERFACE.status_effect: affected active descendant receipts become STALE_PENDING_REVALIDATION, not historically invalid
must_not: change semantic role/meaning under guise of schema repair

revalidate: all active receipts that cite superseded authority, scoped to affected identities
C2_AUTHORITY.status_effect: append successor authority; never mutate frozen release

C3_ARCHITECTURE.description: Layer ownership, gate predicate, inference ceiling, privacy or jurisdiction change.
revalidate: affected stage and all execution descendants under new architecture
C3_ARCHITECTURE.status_effect: new architecture version and explicit migration/differential required
must_not: hide architecture change inside implementation patch

C4_DATA_EXECUTION.description: Extraction/input/scope execution correction under unchanged authority.

frontier_rule: Every work item must name the exact acceptance predicate it advances. An upstream repair lane is legal only when a demonstrated defect blocks that predicate.
rollback_rule: Promote by pointer after differential acceptance; rollback by pointer to last compatible receipt. Never erase receipts.
